name: Order
description: v2 Order — the sales header linking a customer to a car with the agreed total. NOTE: in the legacy data Orders were used loosely as payment-tranche records (PROCESS-MAP §2/§7 Q2). v2 default treats Order as the sales header and moves partial payments to the Payment entity (payment.order_id). If the owner prefers Orders-as-tranches, this stays and Payment.order_id is dropped. status uses codes. RLS: manager+/employee.
